content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) Standards of Care in Diabetes offers updated clinical practice guidelines aimed at improving the quality of care for individuals with diabetes. These guidelines include specific recommendations for managing diabetes-related complications, with a particular focus on chronic kidney disease (CKD). They outline detailed management objectives, screening procedures, and therapeutic strategies designed to mitigate the progression of CKD and address the heightened cardiovascular risks associated with this condition in diabetic patients.
